entries.visual_spec: [blocks/nav/chameleon/domain-tab-topbar-account] header: flex h-14(56px) flex-shrink-0 items-center gap-4(16px) border-b border-stone-200/70 bg=var(--color-paper)(#fffefb) px-4(16px)。品牌 Link: flex items-center gap-2.5(10px)，img /logo-sm.png h-7 w-7(28px) object-contain，span text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight text-stone-800(#292524)。分隔 span h-5(20px) w-px bg-stone-200。域 nav: flex items-center gap-1(4px)；每个域 Link: flex items-center gap-2(8px) rounded-[10px] px-3.5(14px) py-2(8px) text-[13.5px] font-semibold；active=bg-blue-50(#eff6ff) text-blue-700(#1d4ed8) + icon text-blue-600(#2563eb)；default=text-stone-600(#57534e) hover:bg-stone-100/70 hover:text-stone-900 + icon text-stone-400(#a8a29e)；域 icon h-[17px] w-[17px](17px, lucide Boxes/Database/Telescope/Settings)。右侧 ml-auto：AccountMenu 头像按钮 rounded-full + focus-visible:ring-2 ring-blue-500/40，img /default-avatar.jpg h-8 w-8(32px) rounded-full object-cover。Dropdown content: w-64(256px) rounded-xl(12px) border-stone-200/80 p-1.5(6px) shadow=var(--shadow-pop)；用户头部 flex gap-3 px-2.5 py-2.5 含 h-9 w-9(36px) 头像 + 用户名 text-[13.5px] font-semibold + email text-[11.5px] text-stone-400；item gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-[13px]，含 API 文档(BookOpen)/系统配置(Settings)/退出(LogOut, text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50)。lucide: BookOpen/LogOut/Settings。与 waveflow/topbar-search-ping 区分：那个 h-12 暖底 + 260px 搜索按钮 + emerald ping 在线 dot、无头像；本条 h-14 paper 底 + 左对齐域 tab 药丸 + 右上头像账户菜单、搜索移到 ⌘K。

[components/avatars-icons/chameleon/provider-brand-avatar] 外层: flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg(=8) font-semibold ring-1 ring-inset; sm=h-8 w-8(=32) text-[11px], md=h-10 w-10(=40) text-[13px]。品牌色对(bg/text/ring): deepseek 'DS' blue-50/blue-600/blue-100; qwen '通' violet-50/violet-600/violet-100; openai 'AI' emerald-50/emerald-600/emerald-100; new-api&oneapi '⇄' primary-50/primary-600/primary-100; dify 'Di' indigo; fastgpt 'FG' cyan; coze 'Cz' amber。fallback stone-100/stone-500/stone-200 首两字母大写。

[components/avatars-icons/chameleon/gradient-bot-avatar] h-6 w-6(24) shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-500(#8b5cf6) to-blue-500(#3b82f6) text-white flex items-center justify-center，内含 Bot lucide h-3.5 w-3.5(14)。对比列头变体：h-4 w-4(16) rounded(4) 同渐变作色块。

[components/buttons/chameleon/themeable-cva-button] base: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5(6px) whitespace-nowrap rounded-md(6px) font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-200. 9 variant: primary/default 'bg-primary-600 text-white hover:bg-primary-700 active:bg-primary-800'(primary-600 默认=#2563eb 但随 data-primary 切换 purple#9333ea/green#059669/orange#ea580c/rose#e11d48/cyan#0891b2...); outline 'border border-stone-300 bg-white text-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-50 active:bg-stone-100'; secondary 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-200'(waveflow 无此 variant); ghost 'text-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-100 active:bg-stone-200'; link 'text-primary-600 hover:underline underline-offset-2'; danger 'bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 active:bg-red-800'(#dc2626); danger-outline 'border border-red-300 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 active:bg-red-100'; dark 'bg-stone-900 text-white hover:bg-stone-800 active:bg-stone-700'. 6 size: sm 'h-7(28px) px-2.5(10px) text-[11.5px]'; md/default 'h-8(32px) px-3(12px) text-[12.5px]'; lg 'h-9(36px) px-4(16px) text-[14px]'; icon 'h-8 w-8 p-0'; icon-sm 'h-7 w-7 p-0'. defaultVariants={variant:'primary', size:'md'}. loading 时前置 <Loader2 className='h-3.5 w-3.5(14px) animate-spin'/> 并 disabled。lucide: Loader2。

[components/display/chameleon/distribution-top-bars-card] Card>CardContent pt-5(20)。h3 mb-3 text-sm font-medium stone-900。ul space-y-2.5(10)。行：label truncate text-[12px] stone-700 + count tnum stone-500 + 百分比 stone-400 toFixed(0)%；条 h-1.5 w-full rounded bg-stone-100，内填 bg-primary-400 width=count/total%。Top 表变体：进度条 h-1.5 w-16 + bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-300 to-primary-500，配 RankBadge。

[components/indicators/chameleon/channel-score-bars] full 模式 ChannelRow: label w-16 text-right text-[10.5px] stone-500 + 进度条 h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full bg-stone-100 内填(向量 bg-sky-500/关键词 bg-amber-500/精排 bg-violet-500) width=clampPct(v*100)% + 值 w-9 text-right font-mono text-[10.5px] tabular-nums stone-600。compact: flex-wrap gap-x-2.5，每通道「向量 88%」short text-[10.5px] stone-500 + font-mono stone-700。

[components/tags-badges/chameleon/score-heat-cell] scoreBg: ≥0.8 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 / 0.5–0.8 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 / <0.5 bg-red-50 text-red-700 / 空 bg-stone-100 text-stone-400。scoreColor: emerald-600/amber-600/red-600/stone-400。值 toFixed(2)，tnum font-mono。矩阵单元格用法：rounded px-2 py-1 tnum w-full text-left。

[components/display/chameleon/dynamic-virtual-list] 滚动容器: div ref + overflow-y-auto + className(须含高度 h-full/max-h-[...])。内层: relative w-full style.height=virtualizer.getTotalSize()。每虚拟项: div data-index ref=measureElement absolute left-0 top-0 w-full + itemClassName，style.transform=translateY(vi.start px)。estimateSize 默认60，overscan 默认8。stickToBottom 时 items 变化 scrollToIndex(last,{align:'end'})。无固定视觉色——纯结构组件，色彩由 renderItem 自管。

[components/display/chameleon/json-cell-collapsible] null 显 —。短 string(<=80) 'text-stone-700'。折叠按钮: 'block max-w-full truncate text-left font-mono text-[11px] text-stone-600 hover:text-stone-900'，open 时显 '▾ 收起' else summary（preview 或 oneLine 截 80+…）。展开 pre: 'mt-1 max-h-64(256px) overflow-auto rounded-md(6px) bg-stone-50 p-2(8px) font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-stone-700'。pickPreview 取对象 .preview 字段（截 100 字）。 [components/feedback/chameleon/zero-dep-json-viewer] 外框: flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-md(6) border border-stone-200 bg-white。搜索条(searchable): flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-stone-200 bg-stone-50/60 px-2 py-1.5，Search h-3.5 w-3.5(14) text-stone-400 + input flex-1 bg-transparent text-[12.5px](12.5) outline-none placeholder:text-stone-400 + 复制按钮 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-1 text-[11.5px](11.5) text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-200(复制成功 Check h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600'已复制' 否则 Copy h-3 w-3'复制')。内容区: overflow-auto p-2 font-mono text-[12px](12) leading-snug style.maxHeight 默认'70vh'。节点缩进 paddingLeft=depth*12。值着色: string text-emerald-700(JSON.stringify) / number text-sky-700 / boolean text-purple-700 / null|undefined text-stone-400；key text-stone-700；括号 text-stone-500；折叠摘要 text-stone-400(N items/N keys)。展开按钮 ChevronDown/ChevronRight h-3 w-3(12) text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-600。逐节点复制 CopyButton: ml-2 hidden group-hover:inline-flex rounded p-0.5 text-stone-400 hover:bg-stone-100，Check/Copy h-3 w-3。高亮: mark rounded bg-amber-100 px-0.5 text-stone-900。默认 depth<3 展开。lucide: Check/ChevronDown/ChevronRight/Copy/Search。

[components/display/chameleon/paper-card-shell] Card: 'rounded-lg(8px) border border-stone-200 bg-[var(--color-paper)](#ffffff) text-stone-900 shadow-card'（shadow-card=0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0/5%),0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0/3%)）。Header 'flex flex-col space-y-1.5(6px) p-5(20px)'。Title 'text-base(16px) font-semibold leading-none tracking-tight'。Description 'text-xs(12px) text-stone-500'。Content 'p-5 pt-0'。Footer 'flex items-center p-5 pt-0'。全 forwardRef。

[components/display/chameleon/recharts-time-series] 空态 'flex items-center justify-center text-sm(14px) text-stone-400'（默认 '暂无数据'）。CartesianGrid strokeDasharray='3 3' stroke='rgb(0 0 0/6%)'。XAxis/YAxis stroke='#999' fontSize=11。双轴时 left/right YAxis（right orientation='right'）。Tooltip contentStyle{background:'var(--color-paper)'(#ffffff), border:'1px solid rgb(0 0 0/10%)', borderRadius:8, fontSize:12}。Line type='monotone' strokeWidth={2} dot={false}，颜色由 series.color 传入（建议 'var(--color-primary-600)' 随主题）。height 默认 256。recharts: CartesianGrid/Line/LineChart/ResponsiveContainer/Tooltip/XAxis/YAxis。signature: 半透明黑网格(rgb 0 0 0/6%) + paper 底 tooltip + themeable primary 线色 + 双轴。
